## Activity

During April 2021, Oakridge Primary Care recorded 25 captures. Activity was completed in line with the planned session arrangements. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. There were no reported changes to the scheduled operating arrangements.

The recorded activity provides the basis for the image quality and grading results set out below. The capture total is used as the reference for reporting the proportion of ungradable images.

## Image quality

Of the 25 captures, 2 were assessed as ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 8.0. The result identifies the images requiring consideration when reviewing the overall quality of activity for the month. The ungradable cases should remain visible in routine monitoring and service review.

## Grading

A total of 3 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 1 day. Together, the referable result count and the median grading lag provide a summary of grading outcomes and timeliness for April 2021. These results should be considered alongside the activity level and the image quality findings when reviewing Oakridge Primary Care operations.
